question: A retailer offers two successive discounts of 25% and 20% on an item. What is the net percentage discount offered?
explanation: Using successive percentage formula x + y + (xy / 100) with x = -25 and y = -20: -25 - 20 + ((-25) * (-20)) / 100 = -45 + 5 = -40%. The negative sign indicates a net discount of 40%. Option A simply adds the two discounts.
question_hi: एक खुदरा विक्रेता किसी वस्तु पर 25% और 20% की दो क्रमिक छूट देता है। दी जाने वाली शुद्ध प्रतिशत छूट क्या है?
explanation_hi: x = -25 और y = -20 के साथ क्रमिक प्रतिशत सूत्र x + y + (xy / 100) का उपयोग करते हुए: -25 - 20 + ((-25) * (-20)) / 100 = -45 + 5 = -40%। ऋणात्मक चिह्न 40% की शुद्ध छूट को दर्शाता है। विकल्प A दोनों छूटों को सीधे जोड़ देता है।

question:
If three-quarters of residents in a residential complex own vehicles,
and furthermore, two-thirds of vehicle owners own a sedan,
then what percentage of residents own sedans?
explanation: The fraction of residents owning a sedan is given by 2/3 of 3/4 = (2/3) * (3/4) = 6/12 = 1/2. Converting this fraction into a percentage gives (1/2) * 100 = 50%. Option B is the correct answer, while 25% is a common multiplication slip.
question_hi:
यदि एक आवासीय परिसर के तीन-चौथाई निवासी वाहन रखते हैं,
और इसके अलावा, वाहन मालिकों में से दो-थाई के पास सिडान है,
तो कितने प्रतिशत निवासियों के पास सिडान है?
explanation_hi: सिडान रखने वाले निवासियों का अंश (2/3) * (3/4) = 6/12 = 1/2 है। इसे प्रतिशत में बदलने पर (1/2) * 100 = 50% प्राप्त होता है। विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।

question: What is the exact value of 10% of 20% of 50%?
explanation: Calculating per cent of a per cent: (10/100) * (20/100) * (50/100) = 1000 / 1000000 = 1/100 = 1%. Option A is correct, whereas 0.1% comes from missing a division factor.

question:
A bicycle was sold at a profit of 15%.
What is the selling price of the bicycle if the shopkeeper procured it at a cost of Rs. 1200?
explanation: Selling Price = [(100 + Profit %) / 100] * C.P. = (115 / 100) * 1200 = 115 * 12 = Rs. 1380. Option B is correct; Rs. 1320 results from miscalculating 15% as 10% plus an error.
question_hi:
एक साइकिल 15% के लाभ पर बेची गई।
यदि दुकानदार ने इसे 1200 रुपये की लागत पर खरीदा था, तो साइकिल का विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?

question:
An article is sold for Rs. 3000 at a profit of 25%.
What would have been the actual profit or loss if it had been sold at Rs. 2160?
explanation: First, find C.P. = 3000 * (100 / 125) = 2400. New S.P. = 2160. Since S.P. < C.P., there is a loss of 2400 - 2160 = 240. Loss % = (240 / 2400) * 100 = 10%. Option D is correct.
question_hi:
एक वस्तु 25% के लाभ पर 3000 रुपये में बेची जाती है।
यदि इसे 2160 रुपये में बेचा जाता, तो वास्तविक लाभ या हानि क्या होती?

question:
A vendor buys toys at 3 for a rupee.
He then buys the same number of toys from another shop at 2 for a rupee.
He mixes them together and sells them at 2 for a rupee.
What is his overall profit or loss percentage?
explanation: C.P. of 1 toy from 1st shop = 1/3. C.P. of 1 toy from 2nd shop = 1/2. C.P. of 2 mixed toys = 1/3 + 1/2 = 5/6. C.P. of 1 toy = 5/12. S.P. of 1 toy = 1/2. Profit = 1/2 - 5/12 = 1/12. Profit % = ((1/12) / (5/12)) * 100 = 20%.
question_hi:
एक विक्रेता 1 रुपये में 3 की दर से खिलौने खरीदता है।
वह दूसरी दुकान से उतनी ही संख्या में खिलौने 1 रुपये में 2 की दर से खरीदता है।
वह उन्हें मिलाता है और 1 रुपये में 2 की दर से बेच देता है।
उसका कुल लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत क्या है?

question:
A dealer bought a watch at a loss of 6%.
If he had received Rs. 1200 more, he would have gained 14% on his outlay.
What did the watch cost him?
explanation: Cost Price = (Difference in S.P.) / (% Difference in profit/loss) = 1200 / (14 - (-6))% = 1200 / 20% = 1200 * (100 / 20) = Rs. 6000. Option C is correct.
question_hi:
एक डीलर ने 6% की हानि पर एक घड़ी खरीदी।
यदि उसे 1200 रुपये अधिक मिलते, तो उसे अपने परिव्यय पर 14% का लाभ होता।
घड़ी की लागत क्या थी?

question:
Consider the number series:
2, 6, 12, 20, 30, 42, 56, ...
What is the 10th term of this series?
explanation: The pattern of the series is n(n + 1) for n = 1, 2, 3, ... Term 1 = 1*2 = 2, Term 2 = 2*3 = 6, ..., Term 10 = 10 * 11 = 110. Option D is correct.

question: If the radius of a sphere is increased by 20%, then the surface area of the sphere will increase by
explanation: Surface area of a sphere is proportional to r^2. Using successive percentage formula for a 20% increase in radius: 20 + 20 + (20 * 20) / 100 = 40 + 4 = 44%. Option B is correct.
question_hi: यदि किसी गोले की त्रिज्या 20% बढ़ा दी जाए, तो गोले के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
explanation_hi: गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल r^2 के समानुपाती होता है। क्रमिक प्रतिशत वृद्धि सूत्र से: 20 + 20 + (20 * 20)/100 = 44%। विकल्प B सही है।

question:
A group of 150 students appeared in a test.
The mean score of 2/3rd of the students is found to be 75.
The mean score of the remaining students is found to be 60.
What is the mean score of the whole group?
explanation: Number of students in first group = (2/3) * 150 = 100, mean = 75. Sum = 100 * 75 = 7500. Remaining students = 50, mean = 60. Sum = 50 * 60 = 3000. Total sum = 7500 + 3000 = 10500. Overall mean = 10500 / 150 = 70. Option A is correct.
question_hi:
एक परीक्षा में 150 छात्र शामिल हुए।
2/3 छात्रों का औसत स्कोर 75 पाया गया।
शेष छात्रों का औसत स्कोर 60 पाया गया।
पूरे समूह का औसत स्कोर क्या है?
